verses.original: וַיַּ֧עַל מַלְאַךְ־ יְהוָ֛ה מִן־ הַגִּלְגָּ֖ל אֶל־ הַבֹּכִ֑ים פ וַיֹּאמֶר֩ אַעֲלֶ֨ה אֶתְכֶ֜ם מִמִּצְרַ֗יִם וָאָבִ֤יא אֶתְכֶם֙ אֶל־ הָאָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֤ר נִשְׁבַּ֙עְתִּי֙ לַאֲבֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם וָאֹמַ֕ר לֹֽא־ אָפֵ֧ר בְּרִיתִ֛י אִתְּכֶ֖ם לְעוֹלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘al mal·’aḵ- Yah·weh min- hag·gil·gāl ’el- hab·bō·ḵīm p̄ way·yō·mer ’a·‘ă·leh ’eṯ·ḵem mim·miṣ·ra·yim wā·’ā·ḇî ’eṯ·ḵem ’el- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer niš·ba‘·tî la·’ă·ḇō·ṯê·ḵem wā·’ō·mar lō- ’ā·p̄êr bə·rî·ṯî ’it·tə·ḵem lə·‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: Now the angel of the LORD went up from Gilgal to Bochim and said I brought you up out of Egypt and led you into the land that I had promised to your fathers and I said I will never . . . break My covenant with you
verses.literalPt: O Anjo de Jeová subiu de Gilgal a Boquim e disse: Eu vos fiz sair do Egito e vos trouxe à terra que, com juramento, prometi a vossos pais (eu disse: Nunca violarei a minha aliança convosco);

verses.original: וְאַתֶּ֗ם לֹֽא־ תִכְרְת֤וּ בְרִית֙ לְיֽוֹשְׁבֵי֙ הָאָ֣רֶץ הַזֹּ֔את מִזְבְּחוֹתֵיהֶ֖ם תִּתֹּצ֑וּן וְלֹֽא־ שְׁמַעְתֶּ֥ם בְּקֹלִ֖י מַה־ זֹּ֥את עֲשִׂיתֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tem lō- ṯiḵ·rə·ṯū ḇə·rîṯ lə·yō·wō·šə·ḇê hā·’ā·reṣ haz·zōṯ miz·bə·ḥō·w·ṯê·hem tit·tō·ṣūn wə·lō- šə·ma‘·tem bə·qō·lî mah- zōṯ ‘ă·śî·ṯem
verses.literal: and you are not to make a covenant with the people of this land but you shall tear down their altars Yet you have not obeyed My voice What is this you have done
verses.literalPt: vós não fareis aliança alguma com os habitantes desta terra, derrubareis os seus altares; porém não obedecestes à minha voz. Que é o que fizestes?

verses.original: וְגַ֣ם אָמַ֔רְתִּי לֹֽא־ אֲגָרֵ֥שׁ אוֹתָ֖ם מִפְּנֵיכֶ֑ם וְהָי֤וּ לָכֶם֙ לְצִדִּ֔ים וֵאלֹ֣הֵיהֶ֔ם יִהְי֥וּ לָכֶ֖ם לְמוֹקֵֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡam ’ā·mar·tî lō- ’ă·ḡā·rêš ’ō·w·ṯām mip·pə·nê·ḵem wə·hā·yū lā·ḵem lə·ṣid·dîm wê·lō·hê·hem yih·yū lā·ḵem lə·mō·w·qêš
verses.literal: So now I tell you that I will not drive out these people before you they will be thorns in your sides and their gods will be a snare to you
verses.literalPt: Pelo que também eu disse: Não os expulsarei de diante de vós, mas eles vos serão por ciladas, e os seus deuses vos serão laços.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י כְּדַבֵּ֞ר מַלְאַ֤ךְ יְהוָה֙ אֶת־ הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה אֶֽל־ כָּל־ בְּנֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיִּשְׂא֥וּ הָעָ֛ם אֶת־ קוֹלָ֖ם וַיִּבְכּֽוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî kə·ḏab·bêr mal·’aḵ Yah·weh ’eṯ- had·də·ḇā·rîm hā·’êl·leh ’el- kāl- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl way·yiś·’ū hā·‘ām ’eṯ- qō·w·lām way·yiḇ·kū
verses.literal: When the angel of the LORD had spoken these words to all the Israelites . . . the people lifted up their voices and wept
verses.literalPt: Ao falar o Anjo de Jeová estas palavras a todos os filhos de Israel, levantou o povo a sua voz e chorou.

verses.original: וַֽיִּקְרְא֛וּ שֵֽׁם־ הַמָּק֥וֹם הַה֖וּא בֹּכִ֑ים וַיִּזְבְּחוּ־ שָׁ֖ם לַֽיהוָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·rə·’ū šêm- ham·mā·qō·wm ha·hū bō·ḵîm way·yiz·bə·ḥū- šām Yah·weh
verses.literal: So they called . . . that place Bochim and offered sacrifices there to the LORD
verses.literalPt: Assim, esse lugar se chamou Boquim; ali fizeram sacrifícios a Jeová.

verses.original: וַיְשַׁלַּ֥ח יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ אֶת־ הָעָ֑ם וַיֵּלְכ֧וּ בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל אִ֥ישׁ לְנַחֲלָת֖וֹ לָרֶ֥שֶׁת אֶת־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: way·šal·laḥ yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ ’eṯ- hā·‘ām way·yê·lə·ḵū ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl ’îš lə·na·ḥă·lā·ṯōw lā·re·šeṯ ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: After Joshua had dismissed the people the Israelites . . . went out to take possession of the land each to his own inheritance
verses.literalPt: Tendo Josué despedido o povo, foram-se os filhos de Israel cada um para a sua herança, a fim de possuírem a terra.

verses.original: וַיַּעַבְד֤וּ הָעָם֙ אֶת־ יְהוָ֔ה כֹּ֖ל יְמֵ֣י יְהוֹשֻׁ֑עַ וְכֹ֣ל׀ יְמֵ֣י הַזְּקֵנִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֶאֱרִ֤יכוּ יָמִים֙ אַחֲרֵ֣י יְהוֹשׁ֔וּעַ אֲשֶׁ֣ר רָא֗וּ אֵ֣ת כָּל־ מַעֲשֵׂ֤ה יְהוָה֙ הַגָּד֔וֹל אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֖ה לְיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aḇ·ḏū hā·‘ām ’eṯ- Yah·weh kōl yə·mê yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ wə·ḵōl yə·mê haz·zə·qê·nîm ’ă·šer he·’ĕ·rî·ḵū yā·mîm ’a·ḥă·rê yə·hō·wō·šū·a‘ ’ă·šer rā·’ū ’êṯ kāl- ma·‘ă·śêh Yah·weh hag·gā·ḏō·wl ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh lə·yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: And the people served the LORD throughout the days of Joshua and of the elders who outlived . . . . . . him who had seen all the great works that the LORD had done for Israel
verses.literalPt: O povo serviu a Jeová todos os dias de Josué e dos anciãos que sobreviveram a Josué, os quais tinham visto todas as grandes obras que Jeová fizera a favor de Israel.

verses.original: וַיָּ֛מָת יְהוֹשֻׁ֥עַ בִּן־ נ֖וּן עֶ֣בֶד יְהוָ֑ה בֶּן־ מֵאָ֥ה וָעֶ֖שֶׂר שָׁנִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·māṯ yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ bin- nūn ‘e·ḇeḏ Yah·weh ben- mê·’āh wā·‘e·śer šā·nîm
verses.literal: And Joshua son of Nun the servant of the LORD died at the age . . . of 110 . . .
verses.literalPt: Morreu Josué, filho de Num, servo de Jeová, com a idade de cento e dez anos.

verses.original: וַיִּקְבְּר֤וּ אוֹתוֹ֙ בִּגְב֣וּל נַחֲלָת֔וֹ בְּתִמְנַת־ חֶ֖רֶס בְּהַ֣ר אֶפְרָ֑יִם מִצְּפ֖וֹן לְהַר־ גָּֽעַשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·bə·rū ’ō·w·ṯōw biḡ·ḇūl na·ḥă·lā·ṯōw bə·ṯim·naṯ- ḥe·res bə·har ’ep̄·rā·yim miṣ·ṣə·p̄ō·wn lə·har- gā·‘aš
verses.literal: They buried him in the land of his inheritance at Timnath-heres in the hill country of Ephraim north of Mount Gaash
verses.literalPt: Sepultaram-no no termo da sua herança em Timnate-Heres, na região montanhosa de Efraim, ao norte do monte Gaás.

verses.original: וְגַם֙ כָּל־ הַדּ֣וֹר הַה֔וּא נֶאֶסְפ֖וּ אֶל־ אֲבוֹתָ֑יו וַיָּקָם֩ דּ֨וֹר אַחֵ֜ר אַחֲרֵיהֶ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹא־ יָֽדְעוּ֙ אֶת־ יְהוָ֔ה וְגַם֙ אֶת־ הַֽמַּעֲשֶׂ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֖ה לְיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡam kāl- had·dō·wr ha·hū ne·’es·p̄ū ’el- ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯāw way·yā·qām dō·wr ’a·ḥêr ’a·ḥă·rê·hem ’ă·šer lō- yā·ḏə·‘ū ’eṯ- Yah·weh wə·ḡam ’eṯ- ham·ma·‘ă·śeh ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh lə·yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: After that whole generation had also been gathered to their fathers another generation rose up who did not know the LORD or the works that He had done for Israel
verses.literalPt: Foi também congregada a seus pais toda aquela geração; após ela levantou-se outra geração, que não conhecia a Jeová, nem tampouco as obras que ele fizera a favor de Israel.

verses.original: וַיַּעֲשׂ֧וּ בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל אֶת־ הָרַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַיַּעַבְד֖וּ אֶת־ הַבְּעָלִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·śū ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl ’eṯ- hā·ra‘ bə·‘ê·nê Yah·weh way·ya·‘aḇ·ḏū ’eṯ- hab·bə·‘ā·lîm
verses.literal: And the Israelites . . . did evil in the sight of the LORD and served the Baals
verses.literalPt: Então, os filhos de Israel fizeram o mal à vista de Jeová e serviram aos Baalins.

verses.original: וַיַּעַזְב֞וּ אֶת־ יְהוָ֣ה׀ אֱלֹהֵ֣י אֲבוֹתָ֗ם הַמּוֹצִ֣יא אוֹתָם֮ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַיִם֒ וַיֵּלְכ֞וּ אַחֲרֵ֣י׀ אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֗ים מֵאֱלֹהֵ֤י הָֽעַמִּים֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ סְבִיב֣וֹתֵיהֶ֔ם וַיִּֽשְׁתַּחֲו֖וּ לָהֶ֑ם וַיַּכְעִ֖סוּ אֶת־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘az·ḇū ’eṯ- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯām ham·mō·w·ṣî ’ō·w·ṯām mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim way·yê·lə·ḵū ’a·ḥă·rê ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ă·ḥê·rîm mê·’ĕ·lō·hê hā·‘am·mîm ’ă·šer sə·ḇî·ḇō·w·ṯê·hem way·yiš·ta·ḥă·wū lā·hem way·yaḵ·‘i·sū ’eṯ- Yah·weh
verses.literal: Thus they forsook the LORD the God of their fathers who had brought them out of the land of Egypt and they followed after various . . . gods of the peoples around them They bowed down to them and provoked the LORD to anger
verses.literalPt: Abandonaram a Jeová, Deus de seus pais, que os tirou da terra do Egito, e seguiram a outros deuses, dentre os deuses dos povos que estavam ao redor deles; adoraram-nos e provocaram a Jeová à ira.

verses.original: וַיַּעַזְב֖וּ אֶת־ יְהוָ֑ה וַיַּעַבְד֥וּ לַבַּ֖עַל וְלָעַשְׁתָּרֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘az·ḇū ’eṯ- Yah·weh way·ya·‘aḇ·ḏū lab·ba·‘al wə·lā·‘aš·tā·rō·wṯ
verses.literal: for they forsook Him and served Baal and the Ashtoreths
verses.literalPt: Abandonaram a Jeová, e serviram a Baal e a Astarote.

verses.original: וַיִּֽחַר־ אַ֤ף יְהוָה֙ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַֽיִּתְּנֵם֙ בְּיַד־ שֹׁסִ֔ים וַיָּשֹׁ֖סּוּ אוֹתָ֑ם וַֽיִּמְכְּרֵ֞ם בְּיַ֤ד אֽוֹיְבֵיהֶם֙ מִסָּבִ֔יב וְלֹֽא־ יָכְל֣וּ ע֔וֹד לַעֲמֹ֖ד לִפְנֵ֥י אוֹיְבֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yi·ḥar- ’ap̄ Yah·weh bə·yiś·rā·’êl way·yit·tə·nêm bə·yaḏ- šō·sîm way·yā·šōs·sū ’ō·w·ṯām way·yim·kə·rêm bə·yaḏ ’ō·wy·ḇê·hem mis·sā·ḇîḇ wə·lō- yā·ḵə·lū ‘ō·wḏ la·‘ă·mōḏ lip̄·nê ’ō·wy·ḇê·hem
verses.literal: Then the anger of the LORD burned against Israel and He delivered them into the hands of those who plundered them He sold them into the hands of their enemies all around whom they were no longer able to resist . . .
verses.literalPt: Acendeu-se a ira de Jeová contra Israel, e ele os entregou nas mãos dos espoliadores para os despojarem, e os vendeu aos seus inimigos ao redor, de sorte que lhes não puderam mais resistir.

verses.original: בְּכֹ֣ל׀ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָצְא֗וּ יַד־ יְהוָה֙ הָיְתָה־ בָּ֣ם לְרָעָ֔ה כַּֽאֲשֶׁר֙ דִּבֶּ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה וְכַאֲשֶׁ֛ר נִשְׁבַּ֥ע יְהוָ֖ה לָהֶ֑ם וַיֵּ֥צֶר לָהֶ֖ם מְאֹֽד׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ḵōl ’ă·šer yā·ṣə·’ū yaḏ- Yah·weh hā·yə·ṯāh- bām lə·rā·‘āh ka·’ă·šer dib·ber Yah·weh wə·ḵa·’ă·šer niš·ba‘ Yah·weh lā·hem way·yê·ṣer lā·hem mə·’ōḏ
verses.literal: Wherever Israel marched out the hand of the LORD was against them to bring calamity just as He had sworn . . . to them So they were greatly distressed . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Por onde quer que saíam, a mão de Jeová estava contra eles para o mal, como ele havia dito, e como lhes havia jurado; e estavam em grande aperto.

verses.original: וַיָּ֥קֶם יְהוָ֖ה שֹֽׁפְטִ֑ים וַיּ֣וֹשִׁיע֔וּם מִיַּ֖ד שֹׁסֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·qem Yah·weh šō·p̄ə·ṭîm way·yō·wō·šî·‘ūm mî·yaḏ šō·sê·hem
verses.literal: Then the LORD raised up judges who saved them from the hands of those who plundered them
verses.literalPt: Jeová suscitou juízes, que os livraram da mão dos que os despojavam.

verses.original: וְגַ֤ם אֶל־ שֹֽׁפְטֵיהֶם֙ לֹ֣א שָׁמֵ֔עוּ כִּ֣י זָנ֗וּ אַֽחֲרֵי֙ אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים וַיִּֽשְׁתַּחֲו֖וּ לָהֶ֑ם סָ֣רוּ מַהֵ֗ר מִן־ הַדֶּ֜רֶךְ אֲשֶׁ֨ר הָלְכ֧וּ אֲבוֹתָ֛ם לִשְׁמֹ֥עַ מִצְוֺת־ יְהוָ֖ה לֹא־ עָ֥שׂוּ כֵֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡam ’el- šō·p̄ə·ṭê·hem lō šā·mê·‘ū kî zā·nū ’a·ḥă·rê ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ă·ḥê·rîm way·yiš·ta·ḥă·wū lā·hem sā·rū ma·hêr min- had·de·reḵ ’ă·šer hā·lə·ḵū ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯām liš·mō·a‘ miṣ·wōṯ- Yah·weh lō- ‘ā·śū ḵên
verses.literal: Israel, however did not listen to their judges Instead they prostituted themselves with other gods and bowed down to them They quickly turned from the way of their fathers who had walked in obedience to the LORD’s commandments they did not do as their fathers had done . . .
verses.literalPt: Contudo, não obedeceram aos seus juízes, porque se prostituíram a outros deuses e os adoraram. Depressa se desviaram do caminho, por onde seus pais andaram em obediência aos mandamentos de Jeová; não fizeram assim como eles.

verses.original: וְכִֽי־ הֵקִ֨ים יְהוָ֥ה׀ לָהֶם֮ שֹֽׁפְטִים֒ וְהָיָ֤ה יְהוָה֙ עִם־ הַשֹּׁפֵ֔ט וְהֽוֹשִׁיעָם֙ מִיַּ֣ד אֹֽיְבֵיהֶ֔ם כֹּ֖ל יְמֵ֣י הַשּׁוֹפֵ֑ט כִּֽי־ יִנָּחֵ֤ם יְהוָה֙ מִנַּֽאֲקָתָ֔ם מִפְּנֵ֥י לֹחֲצֵיהֶ֖ם וְדֹחֲקֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵî- hê·qîm Yah·weh lā·hem šō·p̄ə·ṭîm wə·hā·yāh Yah·weh ‘im- haš·šō·p̄êṭ wə·hō·wō·šî·‘ām mî·yaḏ ’ō·yə·ḇê·hem kōl yə·mê haš·šō·w·p̄êṭ kî- yin·nā·ḥêm Yah·weh min·na·’ă·qā·ṯām mip·pə·nê lō·ḥă·ṣê·hem wə·ḏō·ḥă·qê·hem
verses.literal: Whenever the LORD raised up a judge for the Israelites He was with that judge and saved them from the hands of their enemies while the judge . . . was still alive . . . for the LORD was moved to pity by their groaning under those who oppressed them and afflicted them
verses.literalPt: Quando Jeová lhes suscitava juízes, ele era com o juiz, e os livrava da mão dos seus inimigos todos os dias do juiz; pois Jeová se arrependia em atenção ao gemer que lhes provocavam os que os oprimiam e apertavam.

verses.original: וְהָיָ֣ה׀ בְּמ֣וֹת הַשּׁוֹפֵ֗ט יָשֻׁ֙בוּ֙ וְהִשְׁחִ֣יתוּ מֵֽאֲבוֹתָ֔ם לָלֶ֗כֶת אַֽחֲרֵי֙ אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים לְעָבְדָ֖ם וּלְהִשְׁתַּחֲוֺ֣ת לָהֶ֑ם לֹ֤א הִפִּ֙ילוּ֙ מִמַּ֣עַלְלֵיהֶ֔ם וּמִדַּרְכָּ֖ם הַקָּשָֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh bə·mō·wṯ haš·šō·w·p̄êṭ yā·šu·ḇū wə·hiš·ḥî·ṯū mê·’ă·ḇō·w·ṯām lā·le·ḵeṯ ’a·ḥă·rê ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ă·ḥê·rîm lə·‘ā·ḇə·ḏām ū·lə·hiš·ta·ḥă·wōṯ lā·hem lō hip·pî·lū mim·ma·‘al·lê·hem ū·mid·dar·kām haq·qā·šāh
verses.literal: But when the judge . . . died the Israelites became even more corrupt than their fathers going after other gods to serve them and bow down to them They would not give up their evil practices and stubborn ways
verses.literalPt: Mas, depois que o juiz era morto, reincidiam e tornavam-se piores do que seus pais, seguindo após outros deuses para os servir e adorar; não abandonavam nenhuma das suas práticas, nem a sua obstinação.

verses.original: וַיִּֽחַר־ אַ֥ף יְהוָ֖ה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיֹּ֗אמֶר יַעַן֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָבְר֜וּ הַגּ֣וֹי הַזֶּ֗ה אֶת־ בְּרִיתִי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוִּ֣יתִי אֶת־ אֲבוֹתָ֔ם וְלֹ֥א שָׁמְע֖וּ לְקוֹלִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yi·ḥar- ’ap̄ Yah·weh bə·yiś·rā·’êl way·yō·mer ya·‘an ’ă·šer ‘ā·ḇə·rū hag·gō·w haz·zeh ’eṯ- bə·rî·ṯî ’ă·šer ṣiw·wî·ṯî ’eṯ- ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯām wə·lō šā·mə·‘ū lə·qō·w·lî
verses.literal: So the anger of the LORD burned against Israel and He said Because this nation has transgressed the covenant I laid down for their fathers and has not heeded My voice
verses.literalPt: Acendeu-se a ira de Jeová contra Israel e ele disse: Porquanto esta nação tem violado a minha aliança que ordenei a seus pais, e não tem obedecido à minha voz,

verses.original: גַּם־ אֲנִי֙ לֹ֣א אוֹסִ֔יף לְהוֹרִ֥ישׁ אִ֖ישׁ מִפְּנֵיהֶ֑ם מִן־ הַגּוֹיִ֛ם אֲשֶׁר־ עָזַ֥ב יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ וַיָּמֹֽת׃
verses.transliteration: gam- ’ă·nî lō ’ō·w·sîp̄ lə·hō·w·rîš ’îš mip·pə·nê·hem min- hag·gō·w·yim ’ă·šer- ‘ā·zaḇ yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ way·yā·mōṯ
verses.literal: I will no longer drive out before them . . . any of the nations Joshua left when he died
verses.literalPt: eu também não expulsarei de diante dela nenhuma das nações que Josué, ao morrer, deixou,

verses.original: לְמַ֛עַן נַסּ֥וֹת בָּ֖ם אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל הֲשֹׁמְרִ֣ים הֵם֩ אֶת־ דֶּ֨רֶךְ יְהוָ֜ה לָלֶ֣כֶת בָּ֗ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר שָׁמְר֥וּ אֲבוֹתָ֖ם אִם־ לֹֽא׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ma·‘an nas·sō·wṯ bām ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl hă·šō·mə·rîm hêm ’eṯ- de·reḵ Yah·weh lā·le·ḵeṯ bām ka·’ă·šer šā·mə·rū ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯām ’im- lō
verses.literal: In this way I will test whether . . . Israel - will keep the way of the LORD by walking in it as . . . their fathers did
verses.literalPt: para por elas provar a Israel, se guardarão ou não, como seus pais o guardaram, o caminho de Jeová para nele andar.

verses.original: וַיַּנַּ֤ח יְהוָה֙ אֶת־ הַגּוֹיִ֣ם הָאֵ֔לֶּה לְבִלְתִּ֥י הוֹרִישָׁ֖ם מַהֵ֑ר וְלֹ֥א נְתָנָ֖ם בְּיַד־ יְהוֹשֻֽׁעַ׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yan·naḥ Yah·weh ’eṯ- hag·gō·w·yim hā·’êl·leh lə·ḇil·tî hō·w·rî·šām ma·hêr wə·lō nə·ṯā·nām bə·yaḏ- yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘
verses.literal: That is why the LORD had left those nations in place and had not driven them out immediately by delivering them into the hand of Joshua
verses.literalPt: Deixou Jeová essas nações, sem as desapossar imediatamente; nem as entregou nas mãos de Josué.
